name: Demonfire Plating reduces magic damage taken by 4% and raises Stamina by 6% (#1833)
contract: Demonfire Plating 302549 reads 'Reduces your damage taken by $s1% and increases your Stamina by $s2%.' (rank 2 tooltip: -4% damage taken, +6% Stamina). Effect 0 is native aura 87 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN), EffectMiscValue 126 (all magic schools: Holy/Fire/Nature/Frost/Shadow/Arcane, excludes SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL bit 0), EffectBasePoints -5 with DieSides 1 -> -4 (all verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc). Its handler comment at src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:152 reads '87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN implemented in Unit::MeleeDamageBonus and Unit::SpellDamageBonus' and is consumed at src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp:9427 and :10940 via GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, [...] effect->GetMiscValue() & spellProto->GetSchoolMask()) -- a real native consumer, not a stub, gated by school mask. Effect 1 is native aura 137 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE), EffectMiscValue 2 (STAT_STAMINA), EffectBasePoints 5 with DieSides 1 -> 6, handler AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:202,4510) -- a fully native stat-percent aura. No script anywhere references 302549; both effects are native generic auras. The scenario probes incoming damage from Fire-school spell 524919 (Burning Blade, SchoolMask=SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_FIRE=4, verified in the installed Spell.dbc), which the 126 misc mask includes.
